terbaru.judul: Hereditary Effective Atom Theory for Large-Scale Atomic Structure Prediction
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce Hereditary Effective Atom Theory (HEAT), which integrates Effective Atom Theory into a genetic algorithm to enable efficient global search through a differentiable effective-atom representation.

terbaru.judul: Complete Street Design informed by Multi-Agent Simulation
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper develops a microscopic simulation framework for quantitatively evaluating alternative street designs by explicitly representing heterogeneous road users, including Autonomous Vehicles (AVs), Connected Vehicles (CVs), Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), pick-up and drop-off (PUDO) services, and micromobility users.

terbaru.judul: Beyond the Prompt: Recovering Hidden Concepts in Text-to-Image Models
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents EmbGA, an embedding-space genetic algorithm that recovers concepts present in a set of images but absent from the prompt that generated them.

terbaru.judul: MLFont: Machine Learning-Driven Font Subsetting and Range-Compact Unicode-Range Slicing for Low-Latency Web Typography
terbaru.pelajaran: We present MLFont, a machine learning and optimization framework that learns font slicing strategies from corpora via three stages: (1) a Zipfian High-Frequency Tier (most) isolating top-frequency codepoints; (2) a Latent Co-Occurrence Topic Tier using Online Variational Bayes LDA (Online LDA) or a Deep Neural Network Topic Model (DNNTM)

terbaru.judul: PArcK trees can get as hot as you want
terbaru.pelajaran: We consider the combinatorial game Partizan Arc Kayles as a generalization of Domineering.

terbaru.judul: qGAMMA: A Framework for Optimal DNN Mapping on Multi-Precision Accelerators
terbaru.pelajaran: This work describes qGAMMA, a flexible framework for exploring and optimizing the mapping of mixed-precision Deep Neural Network (DNN) models onto general-purpose spatial accelerators that support a range of fixed- and floating-point precisions.
